History

Passwords began with the first shared computers. In the 1960s the Compatible Time-Sharing System at MIT asked each user for a password, and the idea spread to every system after it. Early passwords were short words, and attackers learned to guess them by trying whole dictionaries, so guidance grew: longer passwords, mixed character sets, and a different password for every place. In 1988 the Morris worm guessed weak passwords across the early internet, and in 2017 the United States National Institute of Standards and Technology published guidance favouring long, memorable passwords over forced, frequent changes. Generators grew up to make strong passwords that no person has to invent or remember alone. The Signature three-lock drill: the learner draws three locks labelled LONG, RANDOM, and ONE PLACE, and checks each new password against all three. A password that fails any lock is redrawn, and the drill ends with the learner writing five passwords that open all three locks. """Password-generator demo for the Password Generator Service record 1: What Makes a Password Strong.
A small working generator: a seeded, deterministic draw from the four
character sets, plus a strength meter. The live tool uses the browser's
secure random source; this demo uses a seeded hash so its output can be
checked byte for byte."""
import hashlib, math
TITLES = ['What Makes a Password Strong', 'Length First: Why Longer Beats Clever', 'Letters, Numbers, and Marks: The Four Sets', 'Random Means Unpredictable: How Randomness Works', 'Passphrases: Four Words in a Row', 'The Dice Method: Rolling Words', 'Avoiding Names, Dates, and Common Words', 'One Password Per Place: Why Reuse Fails', 'Changing Passwords: When and Why', 'Storing Passwords: Memory and Keepers', 'Copy and Paste: Moving a Password Safely', 'Reading a Strength Meter', 'The 12-Character Minimum', 'The 16-Character Standard', 'The 20-Character Vault Password', 'Symbols: When Marks Help and When They Hurt', 'Pronounceable Passwords: Easy to Say, Hard to Guess', 'PINs: Short Numbers and Their Limits', 'Temporary Passwords: One Use Only', 'Checking a Password Without Sending It', 'Keyboard Patterns to Avoid', 'Passwords on Shared Computers', 'Losing a Password: Recovery in Plain Words', 'The Password Generator Service Field Guide Index']
QUERY = 'what makes password strong'
LOWER = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
UPPER = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
DIGITS = "0123456789"
MARKS = "!#$%&*+-=?@^_~"
def seeded_password(seed, length, sets):
    pool = "".join(sets)
    out = []
    for i in range(length):
        digest = hashlib.sha256(("%s|%d|%d" % (seed, i, len(pool))).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        out.append(pool[int(digest, 16) % len(pool)])
    return "".join(out)
def strength_bits(length, pool_size):
    return length * math.log2(pool_size)
def meter(password, pool_size):
    bits = strength_bits(len(password), pool_size)
    if bits < 40:
        return "weak"
    if bits < 60:
        return "fair"
    if bits < 90:
        return "strong"
    return "very strong"
print("Password Generator Service demo - record 1: What Makes a Password Strong")
sets = [LOWER, UPPER, DIGITS, MARKS]
pool = "".join(sets)
pw16 = seeded_password("record-1", 16, sets)
pw12 = seeded_password("record-1", 12, sets)
again = seeded_password("record-1", 16, sets)
other = seeded_password("record-1-other", 16, sets)
print("Seeded 16-letter password: " + pw16)
print("Seeded 12-letter password: " + pw12)
print("Pool size: %d; 16-letter strength: %.1f bits (%s)" % (len(pool), strength_bits(16, len(pool)), meter(pw16, len(pool))))
print("12-letter strength: %.1f bits (%s)" % (strength_bits(12, len(pool)), meter(pw12, len(pool))))
print("Words checked: %d" % len(QUERY.split()))
h = hashlib.sha256((pw16 + "|" + pw12).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: " + ("MATCH" if again == pw16 else "MISMATCH"))
print("Test: 16-letter password has 16 letters - " + ("pass" if len(pw16) == 16 else "fail"))
print("Test: same seed gives the same password - " + ("pass" if again == pw16 else "fail"))
print("Test: different seed gives a different password - " + ("pass" if other != pw16 else "fail"))
print("Test: 16 letters from all four sets rates strong or better - " + ("pass" if meter(pw16, len(pool)) in ("strong", "very strong") else "fail"))
print("Test: 16-letter strength beats 12-letter strength - " + ("pass" if strength_bits(16, len(pool)) > strength_bits(12, len(pool)) else "fail"))
print("Test: generation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256((pw16 + "|" + pw12).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

    return "very strong"

"""Password-generator demo for the Password Generator Service record 4: Random Means Unpredictable: How Randomness Works.
A small working generator: a seeded, deterministic draw from the four
character sets, plus a strength meter. The live tool uses the browser's
secure random source; this demo uses a seeded hash so its output can be
checked byte for byte."""
import hashlib, math
TITLES = ['What Makes a Password Strong', 'Length First: Why Longer Beats Clever', 'Letters, Numbers, and Marks: The Four Sets', 'Random Means Unpredictable: How Randomness Works', 'Passphrases: Four Words in a Row', 'The Dice Method: Rolling Words', 'Avoiding Names, Dates, and Common Words', 'One Password Per Place: Why Reuse Fails', 'Changing Passwords: When and Why', 'Storing Passwords: Memory and Keepers', 'Copy and Paste: Moving a Password Safely', 'Reading a Strength Meter', 'The 12-Character Minimum', 'The 16-Character Standard', 'The 20-Character Vault Password', 'Symbols: When Marks Help and When They Hurt', 'Pronounceable Passwords: Easy to Say, Hard to Guess', 'PINs: Short Numbers and Their Limits', 'Temporary Passwords: One Use Only', 'Checking a Password Without Sending It', 'Keyboard Patterns to Avoid', 'Passwords on Shared Computers', 'Losing a Password: Recovery in Plain Words', 'The Password Generator Service Field Guide Index']
QUERY = 'random means unpredictable randomness works'
LOWER = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
UPPER = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
DIGITS = "0123456789"
MARKS = "!#$%&*+-=?@^_~"
def seeded_password(seed, length, sets):
    pool = "".join(sets)
    out = []
    for i in range(length):
        digest = hashlib.sha256(("%s|%d|%d" % (seed, i, len(pool))).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        out.append(pool[int(digest, 16) % len(pool)])
    return "".join(out)
def strength_bits(length, pool_size):
    return length * math.log2(pool_size)
def meter(password, pool_size):
    bits = strength_bits(len(password), pool_size)
    if bits < 40:
        return "weak"
    if bits < 60:
        return "fair"
    if bits < 90:
        return "strong"
    return "very strong"
print("Password Generator Service demo - record 4: Random Means Unpredictable: How Randomness Works")
sets = [LOWER, UPPER, DIGITS, MARKS]
pool = "".join(sets)
pw16 = seeded_password("record-4", 16, sets)
pw12 = seeded_password("record-4", 12, sets)
again = seeded_password("record-4", 16, sets)
other = seeded_password("record-4-other", 16, sets)
print("Seeded 16-letter password: " + pw16)
print("Seeded 12-letter password: " + pw12)
print("Pool size: %d; 16-letter strength: %.1f bits (%s)" % (len(pool), strength_bits(16, len(pool)), meter(pw16, len(pool))))
print("12-letter strength: %.1f bits (%s)" % (strength_bits(12, len(pool)), meter(pw12, len(pool))))
print("Words checked: %d" % len(QUERY.split()))
h = hashlib.sha256((pw16 + "|" + pw12).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: " + ("MATCH" if again == pw16 else "MISMATCH"))
print("Test: 16-letter password has 16 letters - " + ("pass" if len(pw16) == 16 else "fail"))
print("Test: same seed gives the same password - " + ("pass" if again == pw16 else "fail"))
print("Test: different seed gives a different password - " + ("pass" if other != pw16 else "fail"))
print("Test: 16 letters from all four sets rates strong or better - " + ("pass" if meter(pw16, len(pool)) in ("strong", "very strong") else "fail"))
print("Test: 16-letter strength beats 12-letter strength - " + ("pass" if strength_bits(16, len(pool)) > strength_bits(12, len(pool)) else "fail"))
print("Test: generation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256((pw16 + "|" + pw12).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

character sets, plus a strength meter. The live tool uses the browser's

import hashlib, math

LOWER = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
UPPER = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
DIGITS = "0123456789"
MARKS = "!#$%&*+-=?@^_~"

    pool = "".join(sets)

    return length * math.log2(pool_size)

        return "weak"
    if bits < 60:
        return "fair"
    if bits < 90:
        return "strong"
    return "very strong"

pw12 = seeded_password("record-8", 12, sets)

UPPER = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
DIGITS = "0123456789"

    pool = "".join(sets)
    out = []
    for i in range(length):

    if bits < 60:
        return "fair"
    if bits < 90:
        return "strong"
    return "very strong"

"""Password-generator demo for the Password Generator Service record 11: Copy and Paste: Moving a Password Safely.
A small working generator: a seeded, deterministic draw from the four
character sets, plus a strength meter. The live tool uses the browser's
secure random source; this demo uses a seeded hash so its output can be
checked byte for byte."""
import hashlib, math
TITLES = ['What Makes a Password Strong', 'Length First: Why Longer Beats Clever', 'Letters, Numbers, and Marks: The Four Sets', 'Random Means Unpredictable: How Randomness Works', 'Passphrases: Four Words in a Row', 'The Dice Method: Rolling Words', 'Avoiding Names, Dates, and Common Words', 'One Password Per Place: Why Reuse Fails', 'Changing Passwords: When and Why', 'Storing Passwords: Memory and Keepers', 'Copy and Paste: Moving a Password Safely', 'Reading a Strength Meter', 'The 12-Character Minimum', 'The 16-Character Standard', 'The 20-Character Vault Password', 'Symbols: When Marks Help and When They Hurt', 'Pronounceable Passwords: Easy to Say, Hard to Guess', 'PINs: Short Numbers and Their Limits', 'Temporary Passwords: One Use Only', 'Checking a Password Without Sending It', 'Keyboard Patterns to Avoid', 'Passwords on Shared Computers', 'Losing a Password: Recovery in Plain Words', 'The Password Generator Service Field Guide Index']
QUERY = 'copy paste moving password safely'
LOWER = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
UPPER = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
DIGITS = "0123456789"
MARKS = "!#$%&*+-=?@^_~"
def seeded_password(seed, length, sets):
    pool = "".join(sets)
    out = []
    for i in range(length):
        digest = hashlib.sha256(("%s|%d|%d" % (seed, i, len(pool))).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        out.append(pool[int(digest, 16) % len(pool)])
    return "".join(out)
def strength_bits(length, pool_size):
    return length * math.log2(pool_size)
def meter(password, pool_size):
    bits = strength_bits(len(password), pool_size)
    if bits < 40:
        return "weak"
    if bits < 60:
        return "fair"
    if bits < 90:
        return "strong"
    return "very strong"
print("Password Generator Service demo - record 11: Copy and Paste: Moving a Password Safely")
sets = [LOWER, UPPER, DIGITS, MARKS]
pool = "".join(sets)
pw16 = seeded_password("record-11", 16, sets)
pw12 = seeded_password("record-11", 12, sets)
again = seeded_password("record-11", 16, sets)
other = seeded_password("record-11-other", 16, sets)
print("Seeded 16-letter password: " + pw16)
print("Seeded 12-letter password: " + pw12)
print("Pool size: %d; 16-letter strength: %.1f bits (%s)" % (len(pool), strength_bits(16, len(pool)), meter(pw16, len(pool))))
print("12-letter strength: %.1f bits (%s)" % (strength_bits(12, len(pool)), meter(pw12, len(pool))))
print("Words checked: %d" % len(QUERY.split()))
h = hashlib.sha256((pw16 + "|" + pw12).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: " + ("MATCH" if again == pw16 else "MISMATCH"))
print("Test: 16-letter password has 16 letters - " + ("pass" if len(pw16) == 16 else "fail"))
print("Test: same seed gives the same password - " + ("pass" if again == pw16 else "fail"))
print("Test: different seed gives a different password - " + ("pass" if other != pw16 else "fail"))
print("Test: 16 letters from all four sets rates strong or better - " + ("pass" if meter(pw16, len(pool)) in ("strong", "very strong") else "fail"))
print("Test: 16-letter strength beats 12-letter strength - " + ("pass" if strength_bits(16, len(pool)) > strength_bits(12, len(pool)) else "fail"))
print("Test: generation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256((pw16 + "|" + pw12).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

secure random source; this demo uses a seeded hash so its output can be
checked byte for byte."""
import hashlib, math

QUERY = 'character minimum'
LOWER = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
UPPER = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
DIGITS = "0123456789"
MARKS = "!#$%&*+-=?@^_~"
def seeded_password(seed, length, sets):
    pool = "".join(sets)
    out = []
    for i in range(length):
        digest = hashlib.sha256(("%s|%d|%d" % (seed, i, len(pool))).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        out.append(pool[int(digest, 16) % len(pool)])
    return "".join(out)

    return length * math.log2(pool_size)

    if bits < 60:
        return "fair"
    if bits < 90:
        return "strong"
    return "very strong"

A small working generator: a seeded, deterministic draw from the four
character sets, plus a strength meter. The live tool uses the browser's
secure random source; this demo uses a seeded hash so its output can be
checked byte for byte."""
import hashlib, math
TITLES = ['What Makes a Password Strong', 'Length First: Why Longer Beats Clever', 'Letters, Numbers, and Marks: The Four Sets', 'Random Means Unpredictable: How Randomness Works', 'Passphrases: Four Words in a Row', 'The Dice Method: Rolling Words', 'Avoiding Names, Dates, and Common Words', 'One Password Per Place: Why Reuse Fails', 'Changing Passwords: When and Why', 'Storing Passwords: Memory and Keepers', 'Copy and Paste: Moving a Password Safely', 'Reading a Strength Meter', 'The 12-Character Minimum', 'The 16-Character Standard', 'The 20-Character Vault Password', 'Symbols: When Marks Help and When They Hurt', 'Pronounceable Passwords: Easy to Say, Hard to Guess', 'PINs: Short Numbers and Their Limits', 'Temporary Passwords: One Use Only', 'Checking a Password Without Sending It', 'Keyboard Patterns to Avoid', 'Passwords on Shared Computers', 'Losing a Password: Recovery in Plain Words', 'The Password Generator Service Field Guide Index']
QUERY = 'character vault password'
LOWER = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
UPPER = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
DIGITS = "0123456789"
MARKS = "!#$%&*+-=?@^_~"
def seeded_password(seed, length, sets):
    pool = "".join(sets)
    out = []
    for i in range(length):
        digest = hashlib.sha256(("%s|%d|%d" % (seed, i, len(pool))).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        out.append(pool[int(digest, 16) % len(pool)])
    return "".join(out)
def strength_bits(length, pool_size):
    return length * math.log2(pool_size)

    bits = strength_bits(len(password), pool_size)
    if bits < 40:
        return "weak"
    if bits < 60:
        return "fair"
    if bits < 90:
        return "strong"
    return "very strong"

pw12 = seeded_password("record-15", 12, sets)

"""Password-generator demo for the Password Generator Service record 17: Pronounceable Passwords: Easy to Say, Hard to Guess.
A small working generator: a seeded, deterministic draw from the four
character sets, plus a strength meter. The live tool uses the browser's
secure random source; this demo uses a seeded hash so its output can be
checked byte for byte."""
import hashlib, math
TITLES = ['What Makes a Password Strong', 'Length First: Why Longer Beats Clever', 'Letters, Numbers, and Marks: The Four Sets', 'Random Means Unpredictable: How Randomness Works', 'Passphrases: Four Words in a Row', 'The Dice Method: Rolling Words', 'Avoiding Names, Dates, and Common Words', 'One Password Per Place: Why Reuse Fails', 'Changing Passwords: When and Why', 'Storing Passwords: Memory and Keepers', 'Copy and Paste: Moving a Password Safely', 'Reading a Strength Meter', 'The 12-Character Minimum', 'The 16-Character Standard', 'The 20-Character Vault Password', 'Symbols: When Marks Help and When They Hurt', 'Pronounceable Passwords: Easy to Say, Hard to Guess', 'PINs: Short Numbers and Their Limits', 'Temporary Passwords: One Use Only', 'Checking a Password Without Sending It', 'Keyboard Patterns to Avoid', 'Passwords on Shared Computers', 'Losing a Password: Recovery in Plain Words', 'The Password Generator Service Field Guide Index']
QUERY = 'pronounceable passwords easy hard guess'
LOWER = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
UPPER = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
DIGITS = "0123456789"
MARKS = "!#$%&*+-=?@^_~"
def seeded_password(seed, length, sets):
    pool = "".join(sets)
    out = []
    for i in range(length):
        digest = hashlib.sha256(("%s|%d|%d" % (seed, i, len(pool))).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        out.append(pool[int(digest, 16) % len(pool)])
    return "".join(out)
def strength_bits(length, pool_size):
    return length * math.log2(pool_size)
def meter(password, pool_size):
    bits = strength_bits(len(password), pool_size)
    if bits < 40:
        return "weak"
    if bits < 60:
        return "fair"
    if bits < 90:
        return "strong"
    return "very strong"
print("Password Generator Service demo - record 17: Pronounceable Passwords: Easy to Say, Hard to Guess")
sets = [LOWER, UPPER, DIGITS, MARKS]
pool = "".join(sets)
pw16 = seeded_password("record-17", 16, sets)
pw12 = seeded_password("record-17", 12, sets)
again = seeded_password("record-17", 16, sets)
other = seeded_password("record-17-other", 16, sets)
print("Seeded 16-letter password: " + pw16)
print("Seeded 12-letter password: " + pw12)
print("Pool size: %d; 16-letter strength: %.1f bits (%s)" % (len(pool), strength_bits(16, len(pool)), meter(pw16, len(pool))))
print("12-letter strength: %.1f bits (%s)" % (strength_bits(12, len(pool)), meter(pw12, len(pool))))
print("Words checked: %d" % len(QUERY.split()))
h = hashlib.sha256((pw16 + "|" + pw12).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: " + ("MATCH" if again == pw16 else "MISMATCH"))
print("Test: 16-letter password has 16 letters - " + ("pass" if len(pw16) == 16 else "fail"))
print("Test: same seed gives the same password - " + ("pass" if again == pw16 else "fail"))
print("Test: different seed gives a different password - " + ("pass" if other != pw16 else "fail"))
print("Test: 16 letters from all four sets rates strong or better - " + ("pass" if meter(pw16, len(pool)) in ("strong", "very strong") else "fail"))
print("Test: 16-letter strength beats 12-letter strength - " + ("pass" if strength_bits(16, len(pool)) > strength_bits(12, len(pool)) else "fail"))
print("Test: generation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256((pw16 + "|" + pw12).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

"""Password-generator demo for the Password Generator Service record 20: Checking a Password Without Sending It.
A small working generator: a seeded, deterministic draw from the four
character sets, plus a strength meter. The live tool uses the browser's
secure random source; this demo uses a seeded hash so its output can be
checked byte for byte."""
import hashlib, math
TITLES = ['What Makes a Password Strong', 'Length First: Why Longer Beats Clever', 'Letters, Numbers, and Marks: The Four Sets', 'Random Means Unpredictable: How Randomness Works', 'Passphrases: Four Words in a Row', 'The Dice Method: Rolling Words', 'Avoiding Names, Dates, and Common Words', 'One Password Per Place: Why Reuse Fails', 'Changing Passwords: When and Why', 'Storing Passwords: Memory and Keepers', 'Copy and Paste: Moving a Password Safely', 'Reading a Strength Meter', 'The 12-Character Minimum', 'The 16-Character Standard', 'The 20-Character Vault Password', 'Symbols: When Marks Help and When They Hurt', 'Pronounceable Passwords: Easy to Say, Hard to Guess', 'PINs: Short Numbers and Their Limits', 'Temporary Passwords: One Use Only', 'Checking a Password Without Sending It', 'Keyboard Patterns to Avoid', 'Passwords on Shared Computers', 'Losing a Password: Recovery in Plain Words', 'The Password Generator Service Field Guide Index']
QUERY = 'checking password without sending'
LOWER = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
UPPER = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
DIGITS = "0123456789"
MARKS = "!#$%&*+-=?@^_~"
def seeded_password(seed, length, sets):
    pool = "".join(sets)
    out = []
    for i in range(length):
        digest = hashlib.sha256(("%s|%d|%d" % (seed, i, len(pool))).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        out.append(pool[int(digest, 16) % len(pool)])
    return "".join(out)
def strength_bits(length, pool_size):
    return length * math.log2(pool_size)
def meter(password, pool_size):
    bits = strength_bits(len(password), pool_size)
    if bits < 40:
        return "weak"
    if bits < 60:
        return "fair"
    if bits < 90:
        return "strong"
    return "very strong"
print("Password Generator Service demo - record 20: Checking a Password Without Sending It")
sets = [LOWER, UPPER, DIGITS, MARKS]
pool = "".join(sets)
pw16 = seeded_password("record-20", 16, sets)
pw12 = seeded_password("record-20", 12, sets)
again = seeded_password("record-20", 16, sets)
other = seeded_password("record-20-other", 16, sets)
print("Seeded 16-letter password: " + pw16)
print("Seeded 12-letter password: " + pw12)
print("Pool size: %d; 16-letter strength: %.1f bits (%s)" % (len(pool), strength_bits(16, len(pool)), meter(pw16, len(pool))))
print("12-letter strength: %.1f bits (%s)" % (strength_bits(12, len(pool)), meter(pw12, len(pool))))
print("Words checked: %d" % len(QUERY.split()))
h = hashlib.sha256((pw16 + "|" + pw12).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: " + ("MATCH" if again == pw16 else "MISMATCH"))
print("Test: 16-letter password has 16 letters - " + ("pass" if len(pw16) == 16 else "fail"))
print("Test: same seed gives the same password - " + ("pass" if again == pw16 else "fail"))
print("Test: different seed gives a different password - " + ("pass" if other != pw16 else "fail"))
print("Test: 16 letters from all four sets rates strong or better - " + ("pass" if meter(pw16, len(pool)) in ("strong", "very strong") else "fail"))
print("Test: 16-letter strength beats 12-letter strength - " + ("pass" if strength_bits(16, len(pool)) > strength_bits(12, len(pool)) else "fail"))
print("Test: generation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256((pw16 + "|" + pw12).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

UPPER = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"

History

Passwords began with the first shared computers. In the 1960s the Compatible Time-Sharing System at MIT asked each user for a password, and the idea spread to every system after it. Early passwords were short words, and attackers learned to guess them by trying whole dictionaries, so guidance grew: longer passwords, mixed character sets, and a different password for every place. In 1988 the Morris worm guessed weak passwords across the early internet, and in 2017 the United States National Institute of Standards and Technology published guidance favouring long, memorable passwords over forced, frequent changes. Generators grew up to make strong passwords that no person has to invent or remember alone. program:
"""Password-generator demo for the Password Generator Service record 24: The Password Generator Service Field Guide Index.
A small working generator: a seeded, deterministic draw from the four
character sets, plus a strength meter. The live tool uses the browser's
secure random source; this demo uses a seeded hash so its output can be
checked byte for byte."""
import hashlib, math
TITLES = ['What Makes a Password Strong', 'Length First: Why Longer Beats Clever', 'Letters, Numbers, and Marks: The Four Sets', 'Random Means Unpredictable: How Randomness Works', 'Passphrases: Four Words in a Row', 'The Dice Method: Rolling Words', 'Avoiding Names, Dates, and Common Words', 'One Password Per Place: Why Reuse Fails', 'Changing Passwords: When and Why', 'Storing Passwords: Memory and Keepers', 'Copy and Paste: Moving a Password Safely', 'Reading a Strength Meter', 'The 12-Character Minimum', 'The 16-Character Standard', 'The 20-Character Vault Password', 'Symbols: When Marks Help and When They Hurt', 'Pronounceable Passwords: Easy to Say, Hard to Guess', 'PINs: Short Numbers and Their Limits', 'Temporary Passwords: One Use Only', 'Checking a Password Without Sending It', 'Keyboard Patterns to Avoid', 'Passwords on Shared Computers', 'Losing a Password: Recovery in Plain Words', 'The Password Generator Service Field Guide Index']
QUERY = 'password generator service field guide index'
LOWER = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
UPPER = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
DIGITS = "0123456789"
MARKS = "!#$%&*+-=?@^_~"
def seeded_password(seed, length, sets):
    pool = "".join(sets)
    out = []
    for i in range(length):
        digest = hashlib.sha256(("%s|%d|%d" % (seed, i, len(pool))).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        out.append(pool[int(digest, 16) % len(pool)])
    return "".join(out)
def strength_bits(length, pool_size):
    return length * math.log2(pool_size)
def meter(password, pool_size):
    bits = strength_bits(len(password), pool_size)
    if bits < 40:
        return "weak"
    if bits < 60:
        return "fair"
    if bits < 90:
        return "strong"
    return "very strong"
print("Password Generator Service demo - record 24: The Password Generator Service Field Guide Index")
sets = [LOWER, UPPER, DIGITS, MARKS]
pool = "".join(sets)
pw16 = seeded_password("record-24", 16, sets)
pw12 = seeded_password("record-24", 12, sets)
again = seeded_password("record-24", 16, sets)
other = seeded_password("record-24-other", 16, sets)
print("Seeded 16-letter password: " + pw16)
print("Seeded 12-letter password: " + pw12)
print("Pool size: %d; 16-letter strength: %.1f bits (%s)" % (len(pool), strength_bits(16, len(pool)), meter(pw16, len(pool))))
print("12-letter strength: %.1f bits (%s)" % (strength_bits(12, len(pool)), meter(pw12, len(pool))))
print("Words checked: %d" % len(QUERY.split()))
h = hashlib.sha256((pw16 + "|" + pw12).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: " + ("MATCH" if again == pw16 else "MISMATCH"))
print("Test: 16-letter password has 16 letters - " + ("pass" if len(pw16) == 16 else "fail"))
print("Test: same seed gives the same password - " + ("pass" if again == pw16 else "fail"))
print("Test: different seed gives a different password - " + ("pass" if other != pw16 else "fail"))
print("Test: 16 letters from all four sets rates strong or better - " + ("pass" if meter(pw16, len(pool)) in ("strong", "very strong") else "fail"))
print("Test: 16-letter strength beats 12-letter strength - " + ("pass" if strength_bits(16, len(pool)) > strength_bits(12, len(pool)) else "fail"))
print("Test: generation is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256((pw16 + "|" + pw12).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))
